en anholdelse.explanation: "En anholdelse" means "an arrest", when the police take a person into custody because they are suspected of a crime.

sentence.da: Efter indbruddet foretog politiet en **anholdelse**.
sentence.en: After the burglary, the police made an arrest.

en ankel.explanation: "En ankel" means "an ankle", the joint you sprain when you twist your foot. The common phrase is at forstuve anklen (to sprain your ankle).

sentence.da: Din **ankel** sidder mellem foden og underbenet.
sentence.en: Your ankle is between the foot and the lower leg.

en anklage.explanation: "En anklage" means "an accusation", a statement that someone has done something wrong, often a crime. You bring one with at rejse en anklage mod nogen (to bring an accusation against someone).

sentence.da: Der er en alvorlig **anklage** mod ham.
sentence.en: There is a serious accusation against him.

en anklager.explanation: "En anklager" means "a prosecutor", the lawyer who speaks in court for the state against a person charged with a crime. Do not mix it up with en anklage (an accusation), which is the charge itself and not the person.

sentence.da: En **anklager** forsøger at bevise, at den tiltalte er skyldig.
sentence.en: A prosecutor tries to prove that the defendant is guilty.

en ankomst.explanation: "En ankomst" means "an arrival", the time a train, plane or person gets somewhere.

sentence.da: Vores **ankomst** er klokken tolv.
sentence.en: Our arrival is at twelve.

en ankomsthal.explanation: "En ankomsthal" means "an arrivals hall", the area in an airport where arriving passengers come out and meet people. It is built from ankomst (arrival) and hal (hall), and hal also means any big hall: en idrætshal (a sports hall).

sentence.da: Passagererne kommer ud i en **ankomsthal** efter landingen.
sentence.en: The passengers come out into an arrivals hall after landing.

en anledning.explanation: "En anledning" means "an occasion", a particular moment that makes something fitting. It can also mean a chance or cause to do something: Jeg har ingen anledning til at klage (I have no cause to complain).

sentence.da: Vi holder en fest i **anledning** af hendes fødselsdag.
sentence.en: We are having a party on the occasion of her birthday.

en anmeldelse.explanation: "En anmeldelse" means "a review", a written opinion of a book, film or restaurant. It is also the word for reporting a crime to the police: at anmelde et tyveri (to report a theft).

sentence.da: Jeg læste en **anmeldelse** af filmen, før jeg købte billetter.
sentence.en: I read a review of the movie before I bought tickets.

en anmelder.explanation: "En anmelder" means "a reviewer / critic", a person who gives an opinion in en anmeldelse (a review) of a book, film or concert. The same word also means a person who reports a crime to the police.

sentence.da: Som **anmelder** ser hun mange film og skriver om dem i avisen.
sentence.en: As a reviewer, she sees many films and writes about them in the paper.

en anmodning.explanation: "En anmodning" means "a request", a formal one, usually written and sent to an authority or a company. Between people, Danes just say at bede om (to ask for).

sentence.da: Myndighederne har modtaget din **anmodning** og svarer inden for en uge.
sentence.en: The authorities have received your request and will answer within a week.

en annonce.explanation: "En annonce" means "an advertisement" in a paper or online. A TV or radio ad is usually en reklame (a commercial).

sentence.da: Jeg så en **annonce** for en ny telefon.
sentence.en: I saw an ad for a new phone.

en ansat.explanation: "En ansat" means "an employee", a person who works for a company. It also works as a describing word: Jeg er ansat her (I am employed here).

sentence.da: Hver **ansat** får en ny telefon.
sentence.en: Every employee gets a new phone.

en ansigtscreme.explanation: "En ansigtscreme" means "a face cream", a cream that keeps your skin soft. It is built from ansigt (face) and creme (cream), and ansigt is also in en ansigtsmaske (a face mask).

sentence.da: Jeg bruger **ansigtscreme** hver morgen, fordi min hud er tør.
sentence.en: I use face cream every morning because my skin is dry.

en ansættelse.explanation: "En ansættelse" means "an employment / hiring", when a company takes a person on to work for it. It names the act, as in ansættelsen af en ny chef (the appointment of a new boss).

sentence.da: Ved **ansættelse** skriver man under på en kontrakt.
sentence.en: When someone is hired, they sign a contract.

en ansættelseskontrakt.explanation: "En ansættelseskontrakt" means "an employment contract", the written agreement between you and your employer. You sign it when you start a new job.

sentence.da: I din **ansættelseskontrakt** står der, hvor meget du får i løn.
sentence.en: Your employment contract says how much pay you get.

en ansættelsessamtale.explanation: "En ansættelsessamtale" means "a job interview", a meeting where an employer talks with a candidate to decide whether to hire them. In daily talk Danes also say en jobsamtale (a job talk).

sentence.da: Til en **ansættelsessamtale** fortæller du, hvorfor du passer til jobbet.
sentence.en: At a job interview you explain why you fit the job.

en ansøgning.explanation: "En ansøgning" means "an application", a letter asking for something, usually a job or a place at a school.

sentence.da: Jeg har sendt min **ansøgning** til firmaet.
sentence.en: I have sent my application to the company.

en ansøgningsfrist.explanation: "En ansøgningsfrist" means "an application deadline", the last day you can send in an application, for example for a job or a study place. Late applications are often turned down.

sentence.da: Den næste **ansøgningsfrist** til uddannelsen er den første marts.
sentence.en: The next application deadline for the program is March first.

en antagelse.explanation: "En antagelse" means "an assumption", something you believe is true without having checked it. The matching verb is at antage (to assume).

sentence.da: Det var kun en **antagelse**, ikke et bevis.
sentence.en: It was only an assumption, not proof.

en antydning.explanation: "En antydning" means "a hint", something said or shown indirectly instead of straight out: Hun gav en antydning af, at hun ville flytte (She dropped a hint that she would move). Unlike en anelse (a slight idea), which you have yourself, an antydning is given or shown.

sentence.da: Der var en **antydning** af et smil i hans ansigt.
sentence.en: There was a hint of a smile on his face.

en apoteker.explanation: "En apoteker" means "a pharmacist", a person with a university degree in medicines, often the one in charge of et apotek (a pharmacy).

sentence.da: Du kan spørge en **apoteker** om, hvordan medicinen virker.
sentence.en: You can ask a pharmacist how the medicine works.

en app.explanation: "En app" means "an app", a small piece of software on your phone or tablet. To download one, Danes say at hente en app (literally to fetch an app), and to open it, at åbne appen (to open the app).

sentence.da: Jeg henter en **app** til min telefon.
sentence.en: I am downloading an app for my phone.

en appelsin.explanation: "En appelsin" means "an orange", the fruit. English uses "orange" for both fruit and color, but Danish has two words: appelsin for the fruit and orange for the color, as in en orange bold (an orange ball).

sentence.da: Af en **appelsin** kan man presse juice.
sentence.en: You can squeeze juice from an orange.

en araber.explanation: "En araber" means "an Arab", a person from the Arabic-speaking world. It describes people by language and culture, not by religion.

sentence.da: Min nabo er **araber** og taler både arabisk og dansk.
sentence.en: My neighbor is an Arab and speaks both Arabic and Danish.

en arbejdsbyrde.explanation: "En arbejdsbyrde" means "a workload", the amount of work you have to handle. Byrde (burden) is part of it, so it often sounds heavy: en tung arbejdsbyrde (a heavy workload).

sentence.da: Min **arbejdsbyrde** er for stor, fordi vi mangler to kolleger.
sentence.en: My workload is too big because we are missing two colleagues.

en arbejdsdag.explanation: "En arbejdsdag" means "a working day", the hours you spend at work in a day. The opposite is en fridag (a day off).

sentence.da: Min **arbejdsdag** slutter klokken fire.
sentence.en: My working day ends at four o'clock.

en arbejdsgiver.explanation: "En arbejdsgiver" means "an employer", the person or company you work for. It is built from arbejde (work) and at give (to give): the one who gives you work. The ending giver works the same in en rådgiver (an adviser), someone who gives råd (advice).

sentence.da: Min **arbejdsgiver** betaler for kurset.
sentence.en: My employer pays for the course.

en arbejdsopgave.explanation: "En arbejdsopgave" means "a work task", one specific job in your day at work, such as answering emails or writing a report.

sentence.da: Min vigtigste **arbejdsopgave** er at svare på kundernes spørgsmål.
sentence.en: My most important work task is to answer customers' questions.

en arbejdsplads.explanation: "En arbejdsplads" means "a workplace", the place where you work. It is built from arbejde (work) and plads (place). Plads also means room or space: Der er plads til alle (There is room for everyone).

sentence.da: Jeg ser mine kolleger på min **arbejdsplads**.
sentence.en: I see my colleagues at my workplace.

en arbejdsskade.explanation: "En arbejdsskade" means "a work injury", an injury or illness caused by your job. In Denmark it can give you the right to compensation.

sentence.da: Man kan få en **arbejdsskade** i ryggen, når man løfter på den forkerte måde.
sentence.en: You can get a work injury in the back when you lift the wrong way.

en arbejdstager.explanation: "En arbejdstager" means "an employee", a person who works for someone else. Its partner is en arbejdsgiver (an employer). You mostly read it in contracts and laws; in daily talk people say en medarbejder (a staff member).

sentence.da: Som **arbejdstager** har du ret til betalt ferie.
sentence.en: As an employee you have a right to paid vacation.

en arbejdstilladelse.explanation: "En arbejdstilladelse" means "a work permit", official permission for a person from another country to work. Many people from outside the EU need one.

sentence.da: Mange udlændinge skal have en **arbejdstilladelse** for at arbejde i Danmark.
sentence.en: Many foreigners must have a work permit to work in Denmark.

en arkitekt.explanation: "En arkitekt" means "an architect", a person who designs buildings and plans how they will look. It is used for both men and women.

sentence.da: Min søster er **arkitekt** og tegner huse.
sentence.en: My sister is an architect and draws houses.

en arm.explanation: "En arm" means "an arm". Danish often says the arm where English says her arm: Hun har brækket armen is literally She has broken the arm, meaning "She has broken her arm".

sentence.da: Hånden sidder for enden af din **arm**.
sentence.en: Your hand is at the end of your arm.

en armbøjning.explanation: "En armbøjning" means "a push-up", a classic exercise for your arms and chest. The usual verb is at lave (to make): at lave tyve armbøjninger (to do twenty push-ups).

sentence.da: Du laver en **armbøjning**, når du skubber kroppen op fra gulvet.
sentence.en: You do a push-up when you push your body up from the floor.

en arrangør.explanation: "En arrangør" means "an organizer", a person or group that plans and runs something like a concert or a race.

sentence.da: Som **arrangør** skal du finde sted, tid og frivillige til festivalen.
sentence.en: As an organizer you must find a place, a time and volunteers for the festival.

en art.explanation: "En art" means "a species", one kind of animal or plant. It also means a kind in general: en speciel art mad (a special kind of food).

sentence.da: En **art** er en gruppe dyr, der kan få unger sammen.
sentence.en: A species is a group of animals that can have young together.

en artikel.explanation: "En artikel" means "an article", a piece of writing in a paper or on a website. For an item in a shop, use en vare (a product).

sentence.da: Jeg læste en **artikel** om vores by.
sentence.en: I read an article about our city.

en arv.explanation: "En arv" means "an inheritance", money or things you receive when someone dies. It also means something passed down, like a tradition: en kulturarv (a cultural heritage).

sentence.da: Børnene fik huset og pengene som **arv**, da deres far døde.
sentence.en: The children got the house and the money as an inheritance when their father died.

en arving.explanation: "En arving" means "an heir", a person who has the right to receive things when someone dies. It belongs to the same family as arv (inheritance), and is also used for the throne: arving til tronen (heir to the throne).

sentence.da: Som eneste **arving** fik hun både huset og alle pengene.
sentence.en: As the only heir, she got both the house and all the money.

en asiat.explanation: "En asiat" means "an Asian", a person with roots in the continent of Asia. The word is very broad, so people usually name the country when they know it.

sentence.da: En **asiat** kommer fra et land i Asien, for eksempel Japan.
sentence.en: An Asian comes from a country in Asia, for example Japan.

en assistent.explanation: "En assistent" means "an assistant", a person whose job is to help someone else with their work.

sentence.da: Min **assistent** skriver mails til kunderne.
sentence.en: My assistant writes emails to the customers.

en astronaut.explanation: "En astronaut" means "an astronaut", a person who travels beyond Earth.

sentence.da: En **astronaut** rejser i en raket til månen.
sentence.en: An astronaut travels in a rocket to the moon.

en asylansøger.explanation: "En asylansøger" means "an asylum seeker", someone who has arrived in a new country and asked to stay there because it is not safe at home. If the request is approved, the person becomes en flygtning (a refugee).

sentence.da: Mens myndighederne undersøger sagen, er man **asylansøger**.
sentence.en: While the authorities look into the case, you are an asylum seeker.

en atmosfære.explanation: "En atmosfære" means "an atmosphere", the layer of gases around the Earth. It also means the feeling in a place, like a room or a meeting.

sentence.da: Der var en varm og rolig **atmosfære** i caféen.
sentence.en: There was a warm and calm atmosphere in the café.

en attitude.explanation: "En attitude" means "an attitude", but Danes mostly use it in the slang sense of a bold, sometimes cocky way of acting. For an opinion or view, they use en holdning (a stance).

sentence.da: Hun går ind i rummet med **attitude** og et stort smil.
sentence.en: She walks into the room with attitude and a big smile.

en aubergine.explanation: "En aubergine" means "an eggplant", the oval vegetable with shiny dark skin.

sentence.da: En **aubergine** er en lilla grønsag.
sentence.en: An eggplant is a purple vegetable.

en auktion.explanation: "En auktion" means "an auction", a sale where people compete with offers and the highest offer wins.

sentence.da: Dyre malerier bliver ofte solgt på **auktion**.
sentence.en: Expensive paintings are often sold at auction.

en autograf.explanation: "En autograf" means "an autograph", what a famous person writes by hand for a fan. To ask for one, say Må jeg få en autograf? (May I have an autograph?)

sentence.da: Jeg fik en **autograf** af min yndlingssanger.
sentence.en: I got an autograph from my favorite singer.

en autoritet.explanation: "En autoritet" means "an authority", someone with the right to decide, or with the trust others give because of what they know: en autoritet på området (an authority in the field). For government offices, Danes say myndighederne (the authorities).

sentence.da: En lærer er en **autoritet** i klassen.
sentence.en: A teacher is an authority in the class.

en autostol.explanation: "En autostol" means "a car seat", the seat that keeps a child safe in a car.

sentence.da: Barnet skal sidde i en **autostol** i bilen.
sentence.en: The child has to sit in a car seat in the car.

en avis.explanation: "En avis" means "a newspaper", printed pages with the day's news. Do not mix it up with et blad (a magazine).

sentence.da: Min far læser en **avis** hver morgen.
sentence.en: My dad reads a newspaper every morning.

en avocado.explanation: "En avocado" means "an avocado", a green fruit with a large pit and soft flesh.

sentence.da: Guacamole er lavet af **avocado**.
sentence.en: Guacamole is made of avocado.

et abonnement.explanation: "Et abonnement" means "a subscription", something you pay for again and again to keep getting a service: Jeg har et abonnement på et magasin (I have a subscription to a magazine).

sentence.da: Jeg betaler hver måned for mit **abonnement**.
sentence.en: I pay for my subscription every month.

et adgangskrav.explanation: "Et adgangskrav" means "an admission requirement", something you must meet to be allowed into a program or school, such as passing an exam. It is built from adgang (access) and krav (demand).

sentence.da: Studiet har et **adgangskrav**: mindst 7 i dansk.
sentence.en: The program has an admission requirement: at least a 7 in Danish.

et afslag.explanation: "Et afslag" means "a refusal", a no to an application or a request. It also means a price reduction: et afslag i prisen (a reduction in the price).

sentence.da: Hun fik et **afslag** på sin ansøgning om støtte.
sentence.en: She got a refusal on her application for support.

et afsnit.explanation: "Et afsnit" means "an episode" of a show: Jeg har set tre afsnit (I have watched three episodes). It also means a section of a text: Læs det første afsnit (Read the first section). For a TV show, en episode (an episode) means the same.

sentence.da: Vi så det sidste **afsnit** i går aftes.
sentence.en: We watched the last episode last night.

et agern.explanation: "Et agern" means "an acorn". It ripens in autumn and has a little cap. Do not mix it up with et egern (a squirrel), which looks almost the same in writing.

sentence.da: Et **agern** er frøet fra et egetræ.
sentence.en: An acorn is the seed from an oak tree.

et aktieselskab.explanation: "Et aktieselskab" means "a public limited company", built from aktie (a share) and selskab (a company). In writing it is shortened to A/S after the name, as in Carlsberg A/S.

sentence.da: Ejerne af et **aktieselskab** har hver købt en del af firmaet.
sentence.en: The owners of a public limited company have each bought a part of the firm.

et akvarium.explanation: "Et akvarium" means "an aquarium", a big glass tank with fish and other water animals, or a place with many tanks: Vi så hajer i akvariet (We saw sharks in the aquarium).

sentence.da: Børnene kan se fisk i et stort **akvarium**.
sentence.en: The children can see fish in a big aquarium.

et alarmnummer.explanation: "Et alarmnummer" means "an emergency number", a phone number you call in danger: I Danmark er det 112 (In Denmark it is 112).

sentence.da: Du kan ringe til **alarmnummer** 112.
sentence.en: You can call the emergency number 112.

et album.explanation: "Et album" means "an album", most often for music: Hun har et nyt album (She has a new album). It is also used for photos: et fotoalbum (a photo album).

sentence.da: Bandet har lavet et nyt **album**.
sentence.en: The band has made a new album.

et alfabet.explanation: "Et alfabet" means "an alphabet", the set of letters a language is written with: Jeg kan hele alfabetet (I know the whole alphabet).

sentence.da: Æ, ø og å kommer sidst i det danske **alfabet**.
sentence.en: Æ, ø and å come last in the Danish alphabet.

et alibi.explanation: "Et alibi" means "an alibi", a fact that shows you were somewhere else when a crime happened. It can also mean an excuse: Hun brugte travlheden som alibi (She used being busy as an excuse).

sentence.da: Han havde et **alibi**, for han var i udlandet den aften.
sentence.en: He had an alibi, because he was abroad that evening.

et alternativ.explanation: "Et alternativ" means "an alternative", another option you can pick instead of the first one. It is often followed by til (to): et alternativ til sukker (an alternative to sugar).

sentence.da: Cyklen er et godt **alternativ** til bussen.
sentence.en: The bike is a good alternative to the bus.

et anførselstegn.explanation: "Et anførselstegn" means "a quotation mark", the sign placed around words someone said or around a title. Everyday Danish also says gåseøjne (literally goose eyes) for the same signs.

sentence.da: Et citat står mellem to **anførselstegn**.
sentence.en: A quote stands between two quotation marks.

et angreb.explanation: "Et angreb" means "an attack", both a physical one in a war or a fight and a spoken one in an argument. In sports it is also the move toward the other team's goal. The matching verb is at angribe (to attack).

sentence.da: Holdet sætter et hurtigt **angreb** ind mod målet.
sentence.en: The team launches a fast attack toward the goal.

et anker.explanation: "Et anker" means "an anchor", the heavy metal weight that keeps a boat in place: Skibet ligger for anker (The ship is at anchor).

sentence.da: Kaptajnen kaster **anker** uden for havnen.
sentence.en: The captain drops anchor outside the harbor.

et anlæg.explanation: "Et anlæg" means "a facility" or "plant", something built for a clear purpose. It is usually joined to a front part: et solcelleanlæg (a solar power system), et idrætsanlæg (a sports facility).

sentence.da: Vandet bliver renset på et **anlæg** uden for byen.
sentence.en: The water is cleaned at a facility outside the town.

et anpartsselskab.explanation: "Et anpartsselskab" means "a private limited company", a small company in Denmark. In names it is usually written ApS: Café Sol ApS. It is built from anpart (a share) and selskab (a company).

sentence.da: Hun valgte et **anpartsselskab**, fordi hun ikke vil hæfte personligt for gæld.
sentence.en: She chose a private limited company because she does not want to be personally liable for debt.

et ansigt.explanation: "Et ansigt" means "a face", the front of your head, where you smile and show how you feel.

sentence.da: Øjne og næse sidder i dit **ansigt**.
sentence.en: Eyes and nose are in your face.

et ansigtstræk.explanation: "Et ansigtstræk" means "a facial feature", a lasting part of how a face looks, such as the nose or chin. It is not the same as et ansigtsudtryk (a facial expression), which changes with your mood.

sentence.da: Hans bløde **ansigtstræk** ligner hans fars.
sentence.en: His soft facial features look like his father's.

et ansigtsudtryk.explanation: "Et ansigtsudtryk" means "a facial expression", the way a face shows what someone feels right now. It can change within a second.

sentence.da: Hendes **ansigtsudtryk** viste, at hun var meget overrasket.
sentence.en: Her facial expression showed that she was very surprised.

et ansvar.explanation: "Et ansvar" means "a responsibility", something you must take care of: Det er mit ansvar (It is my responsibility). To accept it, say at tage ansvar (to take responsibility).

sentence.da: Du har et stort **ansvar** på arbejdet.
sentence.en: You have a big responsibility at work.

et antal.explanation: "Et antal" means "a number" in the sense of how many: Antallet af elever er tyve (The number of students is twenty). For the number 5 itself, use et tal (a number).

sentence.da: Et stort **antal** mennesker kom til festen.
sentence.en: A large number of people came to the party.

et apotek.explanation: "Et apotek" means "a pharmacy", the shop where you buy medicine. The person working there is en farmaceut (a pharmacist). Say på apoteket for "at the pharmacy".

sentence.da: Jeg køber medicin på et **apotek**.
sentence.en: I buy medicine at a pharmacy.

et apparat.explanation: "Et apparat" means "a device" or "an appliance", something you plug in and use: Vi har mange apparater i køkkenet (We have many appliances in the kitchen).

sentence.da: Det nye **apparat** i køkkenet er meget let at bruge.
sentence.en: The new appliance in the kitchen is very easy to use.

et ar.explanation: "Et ar" means "a scar", a mark that stays on the skin after an injury has healed. Do not mix it up with et år (a year): the little ring on the å is the only difference.

sentence.da: Han har et **ar** på kinden efter en gammel skade.
sentence.en: He has a scar on his cheek from an old injury.

et arbejde.explanation: "Et arbejde" means "a job" or "work". Danes say på arbejde (at work): Jeg er på arbejde means "I am at work", and at gå på arbejde means "to go to work".

sentence.da: Jeg skal på **arbejde** nu.
sentence.en: I have to go to work now.

et arbejdsmiljø.explanation: "Et arbejdsmiljø" means "a work environment", everything at work that affects your health and mood, such as noise, light, stress and how colleagues treat each other. The authority that checks it is Arbejdstilsynet (the Danish Working Environment Authority).

sentence.da: Et godt **arbejdsmiljø** betyder, at man trives på jobbet.
sentence.en: A good work environment means that people feel good at work.

et areal.explanation: "Et areal" means "an area" as a measurement: how much surface something covers, such as a floor or a field. For an area in the sense of a region or district, use et område (an area, a region) instead.

sentence.da: Haven har et **areal** på tre hundrede kvadratmeter.
sentence.en: The garden has an area of three hundred square meters.

et argument.explanation: "Et argument" means "an argument", a reason you give for your view: Det er et stærkt argument (That is a strong argument). For an angry fight with words, use et skænderi (a quarrel).

sentence.da: Jeg har et godt **argument** for at blive hjemme.
sentence.en: I have a good argument for staying home.

et arkiv.explanation: "Et arkiv" means "an archive", a place or collection where old documents, photos and records are kept in order so they can be found later. It is also used for stored files on a computer, as in et mailarkiv (an email archive).

sentence.da: Byens gamle billeder ligger i et **arkiv**.
sentence.en: The town's old pictures are kept in an archive.

et armbånd.explanation: "Et armbånd" means "a bracelet". It is built from arm (arm) and bånd (band), the same bånd as in et hårbånd (a hair band).

sentence.da: Hun har et pænt **armbånd** om håndleddet.
sentence.en: She has a pretty bracelet around her wrist.

et armbåndsur.explanation: "Et armbåndsur" means "a wristwatch". It is built from armbånd (a wristband) and ur (a watch or clock), so it is a watch on a band.

sentence.da: Et **armbåndsur** bærer man om håndleddet.
sentence.en: You wear a wristwatch around the wrist.

et askebæger.explanation: "Et askebæger" means "an ashtray". It is built from aske (ash) and bæger (cup), the same bæger as in et æggebæger (an egg cup).

sentence.da: Hun lægger cigaretten i et **askebæger**.
sentence.en: She puts the cigarette in an ashtray.

et aspekt.explanation: "Et aspekt" means "an aspect", one part of a bigger question or problem. It is a word for discussions and writing; in everyday talk Danes often say en side af sagen (one side of the matter).

sentence.da: Prisen er kun ét **aspekt** af beslutningen.
sentence.en: The price is only one aspect of the decision.

et atom.explanation: "Et atom" means "an atom", the tiny building block that all things are made of. Words like atomkraft (nuclear power) and atombombe (atomic bomb) start with it.

sentence.da: Et **atom** er så lille, at man ikke kan se det.
sentence.en: An atom is so small that you cannot see it.

et auditorium.explanation: "Et auditorium" means "an auditorium" or "lecture hall", a big room with rows of rising seats, built so many students can see and hear one speaker. Rooms are often named by number: Auditorium 4.

sentence.da: I et **auditorium** sidder mange studerende og lytter til en underviser.
sentence.en: In a lecture hall, many students sit and listen to a teacher.

et autoværksted.explanation: "Et autoværksted" means "a car repair shop", where mechanics fix cars. It is built from auto (car) and et værksted (a workshop), which also appears in et cykelværksted (a bike repair shop).

sentence.da: Bilen er i stykker, og jeg skal til et **autoværksted**.
sentence.en: The car is broken, and I have to go to a car repair shop.
